[Source PDF page 10]
FINDHIGH(ARR)
A function has been constructed that passes the last permutation
NEXTPERMUTATION(ARR)
and returns the next permutation.
For example, if the first permutation order of is 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, the
ARR
function would return an array ordered 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 7.
NEXTPERMUTATION(ARR)
Each call of the function would give the next permutation.
NEXTPERMUTATION(ARR)
So, the second call of the function would return 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 6, 8.
(c) Construct an algorithm that uses the functions , and
FACTORIAL(N) FINDHIGH(ARR)
to output the probability of choosing the best cat. [6]
NEXTPERMUTATION(ARR)
